messages:
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK INITIATED: prod-eu2 runtime pool. Trigger: automated health alert -> 15% 95p latency spike after v1.4.2-hotpatch deploy (tag: v1.4.2-hotpatch, commit: a7f3d9c). Rolling back to v1.4.1.
oncall-jay: Acknowledged. Observed increased tail latency and a few 5xx traces in tracer.
liz: Was the hotpatch enabling the new attention kernel? If so, disable flag please.
release-manager-ralph: Change window still open. Good time to roll back. Can we pin v1.4.1 until we have a tested fix?
mike: Confirming canary showed a small uptick but prod amplified it. Suggest pin and revert the kernel change.
deploy-bot: ACTION: pinning runtime to v1.4.1 for prod-eu2. Command: `redwood ctl pin --env=prod-eu2 --service=runtime --version=v1.4.1`.
sara: Running smoke tests against pinned pool now.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE: prod-eu2 -> v1.4.1. Rollback duration: ~3m10s. No new 5xxs post-rollback (prelim).
oncall-jay: Verified. 95p back to baseline. Turning feature flag off: `ff toggle attention-kernel --env prod-eu2 --off`.
product-ana: Noting this in release notes: v1.4.2-hotpatch reverted due to latency regression. Will update changelog and notify customers if SLA impacted.
liz: Can we schedule a small canary re-deploy with instrumentation only (no kernel switch) to isolate cause?
mike: Yes. We'll repro locally and run profiler on the kernel path. If it's the kernel, we'll prepare a tolerable rollout with gradual traffic ramp + extra telemetry.
release-manager-ralph: For now leave v1.4.1 pinned until triage complete. Postmortem required if root cause > 1 hour. @oncall-jay please open an incident ticket.
oncall-jay: Opening ticket: INC-2026. Adding logs and traces. Will assign to eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: revert-deploy (reintroduce hotpatch) -> hold until PR #4527 passes canary + perf gate. Deploy command snapshot: `redwood deploy --env prod-eu2 --tag v1.4.2-hotpatch --canary 2% --notes "hotpatch kernel repro with telemetry"` (ON HOLD).
release-manager-ralph: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short here. We'll reconvene after triage. :thumbsup:
